about_short_description.short_description: Zep AI provides scalable blocks in AI to build apps in minutes without rewriting code.

product.name: Zep Memory
product.description: A long-term memory service for AI agents that stores and retrieves user interactions and business data as a temporal knowledge graph to provide relevant context for AI applications.

product.name: Graphiti
product.description: An open-source temporal knowledge graph library that underpins Zep's capability to integrate data streams and provide historical context for AI agents.

product.name: Zep LangGraph Integration
product.description: A framework-agnostic integration enabling AI agents built with LangGraph to use Zep's long-term memory for storing and retrieving user facts and conversation context.

product.name: Zep API and SDKs
product.description: APIs and SDKs for adding agent memory capabilities by sending chat messages and business data to Zep, enabling memory retrieval and management in AI applications.

product.name: Zep ChatHistory Class for LangChain
product.description: A class that simplifies adding production-ready personalized memory to LangChain-based AI applications by managing chat history and business data integration.
